title: Render Prysm Hoodi workload
expected_outcome: A local-only Prysm Hoodi StatefulSet overlay has a pinned immutable image, hardened execution, encrypted 500 GiB gp3 storage request, probes, anti-affinity, node selection, and narrowly allowed network paths.
constraints: No deployment, cluster access, validator client, validator key, mainnet configuration, snapshot scheduling, secret, AWS access, or image publishing.
Select and record immutable image reference before writing the workload.
